audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds. At epoch N start, lookahead contains epochs N and N+1 because epoch processing at the end of epoch N-1 shifts out N-1, retains N, and fetches N+1 (computed as current_epoch + min_seed_lookahead + 1 = N-1 + 1 + 1). Verified against mainnet constants: 64-slot lookahead = 2 epochs of 32 slots.
